reference_tables.intro: Listed below is the entire Monster Library found in-game. Integrated within it is also the complete Bestiary with all of the enemy data, locations, and formations.

description.text: Formed from the putrid vapors of a stagnant pond, its filthy sickle cleaves enemies with a frightening speed. They appear in groups, laughing wickedly. Locations: [1] Train [2] Mr. Zhen's Pit Fight
Mutated flesh-eating bat that lives in the plains of the continent. A group of Vampire Bats can wipe out an entire village. It has crooked fangs and claws. Locations: [1] Plains

Without a sound, the giant spider, its entire body covered with long, soft hair, approaches its enemy on legs thicker than a person's body. It injects a powerful, corrosive poison into the anus of its prey, and devours the meat once it has softened. *Inflicts Poison Locations: [1] Plains

A medium-sized wolf that lives on the plains of the continent. It is a mutant subspecies that supposedly appears only in areas where battles have taken place. It is a ferocious beast, whose habit of feeding off the corpses of warriors slain in battle has given it a taste for putrid human flesh. Locations: [1] Plains

Vengeance of kittens killed by humans. Its body is full of maggots. It fakes the cries of babies and devours the mothers that come to check on them. Locations: [1] Zhaoyang Village [2] Mr. Zhen's Pit Fight
Something formerly human. They are unburied bodies under a warlock's spell. They try to grab hold of you while wailing and emitting a horrible odor. *Inflicts Poison Locations: [1] Zhaoyang Village

cells: Mermaid's Tear x2, Holy Mother Bust x2

description.text: Malicious ghost of a girl killed in a horrible manner. She looks sad, but don't sympathize if you want to stay alive. *Inflicts Confusion Locations: [1] Zhaoyang Village

cells: Mermaid's Tear x2, Holy Mother Bust x2
Holy Mother Bust x2, Bronze Dagger

description.text: This beast-ghost guards the graveyard of wolves. It brings trouble to humans that step into its tribe's hunting ground. Its attacks are fast and deadly. Locations: [1] Zhaoyang Village

cells: Holy Mother Bust x2, Bronze Dagger

description.text: What became of an old female cat that drank human blood. Locations: [1] Zhaoyang Village
Ancient god of harvest. It protects the village when sacred, and brings bad luck when wicked. Its kicks are powerful. *Inflicts Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Zhaoyang Village [2] Mr. Zhen's Pit Fight
Monster created by burning a rat and mixing the remains with feathers and drugs. It attacks with a devouring flame. Used as a guard within a seal. Locations: [1] Fengtian

cells: Fire Bat x3, Shiki Bug x2
Mermaid's Tear x2 Mana Leaf x3

description.text: Large flesh-eating spider transformed with magic. It shoots out mountains of sticky web. Used for security within a seal. *Inflicts Poison Locations: [1] Fengtian

cells: Fire Bat x3, Shiki Bug x2
Mermaid's Tear x2 Mana Leaf x3

description.text: Graveyard frog that mutates by feeding on fresh rump meat of young women. It jumps out of the water to catch humans, and spits out its own gut when surprised. *Inflicts Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Fengtian

Make 1000 Frog Mutants devour each other, and the last one remaining becomes a Frog God. Its skin is covered with poison. It eats anything that moves. *Inflicts Paralysis Locations: [1] Fengtian [2] Dalian [3] Mr. Zhen's Pit Fight

Monster that lives in the sewer. It swims around the sewer and crawls out to hunt for women. Its head makes a discordant noise when hit. Locations: [1] Fengtian [2] Shanghai, Huayuan [3] Mr. Zhen's Pit Fight

Evolved kappa. It only eats the flesh of obese men. It sits at the bottom of the sewer until an appropriate prey presents itself. It smiles when hit on the head. Locations: [1] Fengtian [2] Mr. Zhen's Pit Fight [3] Shanghai, Kuihai Tower
Obedient soldiers. They are equipped with weapons and clothes provided for them. Locations: [1] Fengtian
Fierce dog under the spell of a warlock. It only lives to rip apart and devour its prey. A beast with sharp fangs and strong attacks. Locations: [1] Fengtian [2] Mr. Zhen's Pit Fight
Monster that controls water. It can bring on a drought or storm. Watch out for their friendly attitude. *Inflicts Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Dalian
Ancient god of sea wind. It protects the sea when sacred, and brings bad luck when wicked. Travels through space at the speed of light. Locations: [1] Dalian [2] Mr. Zhen's Pit Fight

Spirit of an old sea snake. It strangles people and eats their flesh. It hides in the darkness of the sea and waits for prey, sometimes for years. *Inflicts Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Smuggler's Boat [2] Mr. Zhen's Pit Fight

Jellyfish filled with the body fluid of drowning victims. Many of them gather around the harbor at dusk. Makes a screeching noise like nails scratching glass. Locations: [1] Smuggler's Boat [2] Mr. Zhen's Pit Fight

Li Li's vengeance that grew stronger with Dehuai's power. She lashes out her anger on all living things using dark powers from the other side. *Inflicts Paralysis Locations: [1] Smuggler's Boat [2] Mr. Zhen's Pit Fight

A snake that has grown to immense Proportions from eating buried bodies. It moves freely underground in search of dead bodies or people who are near death. It appears at the feet of its prey without a sound, and before you know it, it has eaten the body up to the knees. Locations: [1] Temple Ruins
Malicious spirit of a man who drowned on land and transformed. It drips oil from its body and makes its prey slip. Locations: [1] Temple Ruins
One of three insects that lives in the human body. It can tear the gut and twist bones when it goes wild. Master Xifa uses it to guard his temple. *Inflicts Silence Locations: [1] Temple Ruins
An evil spirit formed from the dust of graveyards. It speaks, cries and laughs with a dry, raspy voice and confuses and haunts those who visit shrines. Locations: [1] Temple Ruins
The spirit of soldiers who have been killed in unclean ways. Although they carry guns, their tortured souls no longer even recall how to use them. Locations: [1] Temple Ruins
One of three insects that lives in the human body. Lives in the heart and causes depression and shortness of breath. One of Master Xifa's many guards. *Inflicts Paralysis Locations: [1] Temple Ruins

Monster born from muddy water. It hides at the bottom of old wells and sucks life energy from the victims. Be careful if you don't see your reflection in a puddle of water. *Inflicts Confusion Locations: [1] Temple Ruins
Frog that turned evil. It attacks monks-in-training and sucks their brains with the tongue that resembles a human hand. The sweat that covers its body is venomous. Locations: [1] Temple Ruins

One of three insects that lives in the human body. It lives in the head, and causes anxiety, suspicion, and hallucinations. Guards Master Xifa's Ni Wan Palace. *Inflicts Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Temple Ruins

Wugui transformed with Dehuai's power. Ancient god of war. Dehuai revived the god for Wugui to control. Possesses dark power strong enough to kill with one shot. *Inflicts Instant Death, S-Atk Resistant Locations: [1] Temple Ruins
Soldier with specific duties. He must work harder to impress his troops. Very stressful. Carries the same equipment as the elite guards. Locations: [1] Shanghai, Huayuan (2)
Trains other soldiers. Middle management is a stressful job. Locations: [1] Shanghai, Huayuan (2)
Ghost that roams the dark world of Kowloon. It cries, with endless tears, like wind howling through windows. *Inflicts Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Kowloon Fortress

Unbalanced entity that lives in Kowloon. It may be a Kappa that changes to Light Class while swimming in the sewer from Fengtian. *P-Atk Resistant Locations: [1] Kowloon Fortress [2] Sharon's Pit Fight

Dark entity of Kowloon. Rumored to be Wugui's creation, based on the three demons of Kowloon. It wears bondage clothes. *Inflicts Instant Death, S-Atk Resistant Locations: [1] Kowloon Fortress [2] Sharon's Pit Fight
Water ogre used by warlocks. It's powerful and uses magic. Don't let its beautifully choreographed attacks distract you. *Inflicts Petrification Locations: [1] Kowloon Fortress
Fire ogre used by warlocks. It attacks with a large, spiked metal rod. A sad creature that only lives to fight. Locations: [1] Kowloon Fortress
Dark force born of Kowloon's warped space. It may also be city people's resentment collected into one form. Locations: [1] Kowloon Fortress [2] Sharon's Pit Fight
Corpse under control of a warlock. Wugui's soul is gone, and only hate and vengeance remains. It knows no fear or pain. *Inflicts Instant Death, S-Atk Resistant Locations: [1] Kowloon Fortress
Ancient god of faith. It protects religion when sacred, and brings bad luck when wicked. Strikes with red-hot spirit. Locations: [1] Shanghai, Kuihai Tower
Born from evil spirits of the city. It may also be the ghost of a poet who sold out his colleagues after repeated torture. Locations: [1] Shanghai, Kuihai Tower

Spawned from evil. Malicious ghost of an entrepreneur killed by his own family. The protrusion in the nether region commits hideous acts. Brother of Vengeance Demon. Locations: [1] Shanghai, Kuihai Tower
Spawned from evil. Malicious ghost of a poisoned doctor. The protrusion in the nether region represents scorn. Brother of Vengeance and Rage Demons. Locations: [1] Shanghai, Kuihai Tower
Snake that ate more than 1000 babies that died from disease. Its eyes stop people in their tracks. Brings storms with its pig-like cries. Locations: [1] Shanghai, Kuihai Tower

Ghost of a lost monk. It spreads vicious odor and looks into your face from behind. Loves people's misfortunes and despises happiness. It roams the shadows of Kuihai Tower. *Inflicts Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Shanghai, Kuihai Tower
Old Bloodsucking Cat that gained mystical strength. It transforms and devours the victims it tricked. Possesses long, ugly nails. Locations: [1] Shanghai, Kuihai Tower
Dehuai's ultimate skill. He transforms by feeding the darkness of his soul to a god of destruction in purgatory. *Inflicts Petrification & Silence Locations: [1] Shanghai, Kuihai Tower

Ghost of a bell ringer who took his own life. His body was pierced by a pole when he jumped off a bell tower. The story goes that the birds ate his flesh. *Inflicts Silence Locations: [1] Prague [2] Bistritz
Ghost of a mailman who ate all the dogs in town. He despises his own form. His kicks are powerful and unpredictable. *Inflicts Confusion Locations: [1] Bistritz
Evil ghost of a police dog that devoured its owner and the mother dog. He howls with regret for his crimes. The embodiment of hunger. Locations: [1] Bistritz
Kevin's transformed shape. His flesh hangs down like a curtain and spreads a horrible stench. Locations: [1] Bistritz [2] Sharon's Pit Fight

Evil ghost of a hunting dog that searches for prey even after its own flesh rots away. It was left for dead on a mountain by its owner. *Inflicts Paralysis Locations: [1] Blue Castle [2] Sharon's Pit Fight
Bloodsucking bat that lives in an old castle. It searches for dead bodies like a vulture. It attacks strong enemies in a pack. *Inflicts Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Blue Castle
Evil ghosts of knights that died without enough kills. They cry and roam around battlegrounds and castle walls. They're visible to humans on nights with crescent moons. Locations: [1] Blue Castle

Ghost of a knight who hasn't realized his own death. Another theory is that his body was sucked out by an evil master. He believes everyone around him is an enemy. *Inflicts Poison Locations: [1] Blue Castle
Small demon that swings a rusted sickle. It wants to destroy everything in sight. A variation of Wind Shear. Locations: [1] Rouen
Seduced by the God of Death, this gambler shared the same bed with a bat and eagle. He walks the streets of Rouen seeking help. Locations: [1] Rouen [2] Sharon's Pit Fight

Ghost of a general who loved to torture people. He came back from hell to participate in the atrocities at the orphanage. He roams the orphanage in search of cries of pain. *Inflicts Ring anomalies Locations: [1] London, Orphanage

cells: Pure Root x2, Phoenix Tail x2

description.text: Malicious ghost of a young woman who received horrible experiments on her body. Her skin has been ripped off, and she shivers constantly. *Uses SP Lowering Locations: [1] London, Orphanage

cells: Pure Root x2, Phoenix Tail x2

description.text: Servant of Jack, the mansion's master, he has the powers of a lower level spirit. If you hear footsteps from the ceiling or a cackling laugh, beware. Locations: [1] London, Orphanage [2] Sharon's Pit Fight

Jack's beloved mother. She has been revived by her son's experiment, but she is a different being now. A victim of "The Sickle of Life". *Inflicts Petrification Locations: [1] London, Orphanage [2] Sharon's Pit Fight
Changed form of the inquisitor who guards Calios Mental Hospital. Magic has turned him into something inhuman. *Inflicts Confusion Locations: [1] Calios Mental Hospital
Calios Mental Hospital's guard dog. It was thrown into the world halfway through creation. Locations: [1] Calios Mental Hospital [2] Sharon's Pit Fight
Malicious ghost of Calios Mental Hospital. It chases after intruders with its upside-down body. Locations: [1] Calios Mental Hospital [2] Sharon's Pit Fight

Gigantic bug that jumps at your face with slimy wings. Soaked in the hell's venom under Calios Mental Hospital, it attacks any intruders. *Inflicts Poison, Confusion & Silence Locations: [1] Calios Mental Hospital [2] Sharon's Pit Fight

Viscount Rausan's mind realized into form by magic. It's a pregnant woman filled with hate. Inside its belly is evil that reeks. *Inflicts Silence Locations: [1] Calios Mental Hospital [2] Sharon's Pit Fight
Witch that embodies the evil roaming around the city. She steals people's souls with her beautiful voice. She is actually Olga's disguise. *Inflicts Poison Locations: [1] Calios Mental Hospital

Strange entity born from the spirits within Nemeton Monastery. Considered by some as a fallen angel, it is a gruesome mixture of bird, human and plant. *Inflicts Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Nemeton Monastery

Female ghost that began to appear since the monastery burned down. She appears from the underground and disappears into the pond of the sanctuary. She speaks in strange language. *Inflicts Paralysis Locations: [1] Nemeton Monastery
Unblessed life born of Nemeton Monastery's spirit. It has intelligence, but no human emotions. It acts on instinct. *Inflicts Instant Death & uses SP Lowering Locations: [1] Nemeton Monastery
Ghost that has resided in Nemeton Monastery for a long time. It roams among the ruins now. It is a soul that will never be saved. Locations: [1] Nemeton Monastery
Demon that appears in King Solomon's book of magic, Lemegeton. A violent, evil, and cruel soul. Its appearance signifies the end of the world. *Uses SP Lowering Locations: [1] Nemeton Monastery
Golden bat rumored to be the oldest brother of the other bats. He holds important information about the Demon Sword. His low blood pressure makes for miserable mornings. Locations: [1] Blue Castle

Ghost of a young man that roams the Dollhouse. His eyes are missing, and he has fallen out of the circle of life. *Inflicts Paralysis, Confusion, Silence, Poison, Petrify, and Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Dollhouse

Ghost of a girl burned alive. Her skin has fallen off and facial muscles torn away. She cries and walks the shadows of the dollhouse. *Inflicts Paralysis, Confusion, Silence, Poison, Petrify, and Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Dollhouse
A poltergeist-like spirit. It floats in space and attacks with a loud laugh. It loves to surprise people. Locations: [1] Dollhouse
The root of all evil in the mansion with no order. It evokes old memories in people. *Inflicts Paralysis Locations: [1] Dollhouse
Creature that loves human flesh. It likes hot, moist areas and waits patiently for a woman or a child to pass by. If you hear wings rustling in the dark, watch out. Locations: [1] Cave Temple
The creation God's mistake. It resents god and destroys anything that resembles or represents God. *Inflicts Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Cave Temple
Fluid-like creature born from a dark, stagnant pond. With a voice like thunder, it attacks all who would invade its territory. *Inflicts Instant Death Locations: [1] Cave Temple

Malicious ghost that bears the same name as the angel of knowledge. It takes over children's bodies and devours them slowly. Tiny bells ring when it walks. *S-Atk Resistant, and inflicts Paralysis, Confusion, Silence, Poison, Petrify, and Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Cave Temple

Malicious ghost of a vengeful snake. It has the ability to make people fall asleep. The victims are strung up in front of their houses with their heads turned inside out. *Inflicts Petrification Locations: [1] Ancient Ruins
Pet transformed by drinking Asp's saliva. It has lost its mind, but still recognizes its owner's voice. Its breath stinks. *Inflicts Petrification Locations: [1] Ancient Ruins
Realized form of various poisons in the ground. Its body is filled with harmful gas, and it also has eyes on its back. Locations: [1] Ancient Ruins

Incubus that calls itself by an angel's name and flies on the night of new moon with six beautiful wings. It eats the soul of girls while they're dreaming. *Inflicts Paralysis, Confusion, Silence, Poison, Petrify, and Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Ancient Ruins
Half-beast with multiple eyes. Each eye seeks out intruders from different directions. Its green body emits a horrible odor, and it screams as it swings the scythe. Locations: [1] Neameeto
Monster that wears gold armor. Eliminates intruders mercilessly with his fire sword. He guards the Castle of Deranged Gods. Locations: [1] Neameeto
Ghost of a peeping tom. It came in through the underground thruway of the monastery. He remains a peeping tom, even as a ghost. *Inflicts Confusion Locations: [1] Neameeto
Insane bird that flies through the wind of death. Its 5 claws sweep the prey off the ground at the speed of light. *P-Atk Resistant Locations: [1] Neameeto
The creation god's mistake. A beautiful woman with the lower half of a flesh-eating bug. A guard who loves the twisted light of the Castle of Deranged Gods. Locations: [1] Neameeto
Original form of Arcmine. A strange bug that crawls the floors of the Castle of Deranged Gods. It has no soul, and look for rancid bodies while making noise. *Inflicts Silence Locations: [1] Neameeto
Covered by a rock-solid shell. Makes accurate and deadly attacks with its sharp, long claws. The embodiment of destructive forces. Locations: [1] Neameeto
Strange creature born of the castle's spirit. Its soul is dark and full of hate, and the body full of venomous liquid. *Inflicts Paralysis, Poison, and Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Neameeto

One of warlock's demons. It has the power to turn people into stone. This aggressive creature lives in a humid area and crawls around looking for prey. *P-Atk Resistant, Inflicts Paralysis Locations: [1] Neameeto

Evolved Arcmine. It can reproduce. After mating, it lays millions of eggs into the prey's soft flesh. It likes twisted darkness. *S-Atk Resistant, Inflicts Paralysis, Uses SP Lowering Locations: [1] Neameeto
Castle guard who carries a scythe dripping with blood. His small, evil eyes peer out from within his blood-stained hood, and strike fear into all intruders. Locations: [1] Neameeto
Concentration of evil from a castle with many secrets. It's covered with the scent of a fruit that only grows in purgatory. Locations: [1] Neameeto
One of Zhen's pit fight monsters. Usually harmless, but vicious and deadly when provoked by challengers. Approach with caution. *Inflicts Ring anomalies & Silence Locations: [1] Mr. Zhen's Pit Fight
One of Zhen's pit fight monsters. It has taken the lives of many greedy souls. Approach with caution. *Inflicts Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Mr. Zhen's Pit Fight
One of the beholders Sharon can summon. It looks like a normal Wind Shear, but much stronger. Good for travelers testing their ground. *Inflicts Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Sharon's Pit Fight
One of the beholders Sharon can summon. She summons it to train her pack, but it gets out of control sometimes. *Inflicts Paralysis Locations: [1] Sharon's Pit Fight
Evil soul that devours the Harmonixer's "spirit graveyard". It attempts to eat away the Harmonixer's soul on behalf of all the monsters he has killed. Locations: [1] Graveyard (Asia)
Evil soul that lives in the graveyard. The vengeance of monsters killed by the Harmonixer. Locations: [1] Graveyard (Asia)
Evil soul that lives in the graveyard. The vengeance of monsters that took the shape of a snake demon. Locations: [1] Graveyard (Asia)
Evil soul that lives in the graveyard. The vengeance of monsters killed by the Harmonixer. It tries to take the Harmonixer's soul and turn him into a demon. Locations: [1] Graveyard (Asia)
Concentration of disease in the graveyard that took a shape. It acts as the key to open the dark world and release a god. Locations: [1] Graveyard (Europe)
A concentration of disease in the graveyard that took a shape. It acts as the key to open the dark world and release a god. Locations: [1] Graveyard (Europe)
Concentration of disease in the graveyard that took a shape. It acts as the key to open the dark world and release a god. Locations: [1] Graveyard (Europe)
Concentration of disease in the graveyard that took a shape. It acts as the key to open the dark world and release a god. Locations: [1] Graveyard (Europe)
Dark soul waiting for the moment the dark world opens up to the world at large. It represents the Harmonixer's violent desires. *Uses SP Lowering Locations: [1] Red Malice Battles (Europe)
Dark soul waiting for the moment the dark world opens up to the world at large. It represents the Harmonixer's worldly desires. *Uses SP Lowering Locations: [1] Red Malice Battles (Europe)

Dark soul waiting for the moment the dark world opens up to the world at large. It represents the Harmonixer's desire to be lazy. *S-Atk Resistant, uses SP Lowering Locations: [1] Red Malice Battles (Europe)
Dark soul waiting for the moment the dark world opens up to the world at large. It represents the Harmonixer's greed. *P-Atk Resistant, uses SP Lowering Locations: [1] Red Malice Battles (Europe)
Dark soul that represents the Harmonixer's violent desires. It lost against the Harmonixer's conscience, but defeat made it stronger. Locations: [1] Red Malice Battles, after initial defeat (Europe)

Dark soul that represents the Harmonixer's worldly pleasures. It lost against the Harmonixer's conscience, but defeat made it stronger. Locations: [1] Red Malice Battles, after initial defeat (Europe)
Dark soul that represents the Harmonixer's laziness. It lost against the Harmonixer's conscience, but defeat made it stronger. Locations: [1] Red Malice Battles, after initial defeat (Europe)
Dark soul that represents the Harmonixer's greed. It lost against the Harmonixer's conscience, but defeat made it stronger. Locations: [1] Red Malice Battles, after initial defeat (Europe)

Realized form of darkness that exists in every person's mind. It devours Harmonixers' souls and attempts to release darkness into the world. *Uses SP Lowering, and inflicts Paralysis, Confusion, Silence, Poison, Petrify, and Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Nemeton Monastery (Good Ending)
The most evil fusion monster. No Harmonixer has ever fused successfully with this monster. A successful fusion gives Harmonixers the power to perform deicide. Locations: [1] Graveyard

Albert's final evolution, gained through the evil power from the Castle of the Deranged Gods. *Uses SP Lowering, and inflicts Paralysis, Confusion, Silence, Poison, Petrify, and Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Neameeto

Unknown life form referred to as "God" by many people through the ages. Appears in front of those who attempt to discover the true purpose of the "Mad God's Castle". *Uses SP Lowering, and inflicts Paralysis, Confusion, Silence, Poison, Petrify, and Ring anomalies Locations: [1] Neameeto (Final Boss)
